intended_use: A local, explicitly partial ArcGIS Pro side-by-side visual of the two exact RTC VV scenes in EPSG:32645, with attributed image export kept in non-Git custody. No DEM image, public pixel release, change analysis, or scientific publication.

source_evidence.before_VV_VH_XML_use_limit: No restrictions on use with acknowledgement or citation as listed in the product credits.
source_evidence.after_VV_VH_XML_use_limit: No restrictions on use with acknowledgement or citation as listed in the product credits.
source_evidence.image_credit: ASF DAAC HyP3 2026. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed by ESA.

decision: The exact two product metadata sets support only a local credited VV visual panel and local export under the already approved partial-pair envelope. Keep the generated DEM out of displayed and exported layers. Retain the product image credit and two HyP3 DOIs. Any changed provider terms, broader distribution, or public pixel/scientific use requires fresh review; this record is not pair coverage, map fitness, or change evidence.
